**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-house `filter` package — `internal/filter/` (`engine.go` compiles CEL to a dialect-agnostic condition tree via `schema.go`/`ir.go`; `render.go` renders that tree to SQL). Mechanism: `ListMemos` passes filter strings down to each dialect's `ListMemos`, which calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` and `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.DialectSQLite|DialectMySQL|DialectPostgres, &where, &args)` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`, `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`), so the renderer emits dialect-specific SQL fragments + placeholders (per-dialect expressions in `internal/filter/schema.go:104-148`) that are ANDed into the WHERE clause.

**q26.**
```
memo            (store/db/sqlite/memo.go:239 DELETE FROM memo)
memo_relation   (store/memo.go:142-147, both directions)
attachment      (store/memo.go:149-157 via Store.DeleteAttachment)
memo_share      (DB-level FK ON DELETE CASCADE — store/migration/*/LATEST.sql:108-109)
```

Note: comment memos are deleted first by the handler (`memo_service.go:568-577`), recursing into the same set. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built React `dist/` is embedded in the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo static middleware plus an SPA fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-22` (embed), `:41-60` (`FrontendService.Serve`, `middleware.StaticWithConfig` + `spaFallbackMiddleware`), invoked from `server/server.go:70`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — started at server/server.go:157-168: RunOnce(ctx) immediately at startup, then Run(ctx) with a 12-hour time.Ticker (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started by package init() draining a 128-slot queue, triggered per PostAsync call (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54)
email async workers — 2 goroutines started by package init() draining a 128-slot queue (internal/email/email.go:15-20)
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron-expression scheduler with middleware, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `doc.go`) is **not** used by the server — it is imported only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`). Also `server/runner/memopayload` is not a background runner; it is called synchronously from `memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:146-171` (attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, retries once on `Unauthenticated` after refresh; token state in `web/src/auth-state.ts`, refresh via `refreshAccessToken`/`AuthService.refreshToken`, `connect.ts:64-88`). Token kinds: short-lived JWT **access token** (in-memory/localStorage, sent as Bearer) and an HTTP-only **refresh token cookie** (`credentials: "include"`); the backend also accepts **personal access tokens (PATs)** as Bearer. Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go` — `AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2`, `AuthenticateByRefreshToken`, `AuthenticateByPAT`; `token.go`), used through `Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go:27,36` for both the Connect interceptor and the gateway middleware (`v1.go:67-92,131-137`).

**q30.**
```
memo created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called at memo_service.go:157)
memo updated: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called at memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memo deleted: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called at memo_service.go:562)
comment created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called at memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:46`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), whose worker goroutines call `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`) for the actual HTTP delivery.
